name: Restaurant am Rißbach
kurzbeschreibung:
**Restaurant am Rißbach in Pfronten**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the Alps at **Restaurant am Rißbach** in **Pfronten**, nestled between lush forests and the majestic **Allgäu** mountains. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy retreat invites you to savor traditional dishes like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, tender **Schweinsbraten**, and fresh mountain trout—all paired with crisp local beers and crisp white wines.

After your meal, unwind with a stroll along the **Rißbach** stream or take in breathtaking views of the **Zugspitze**, Germany’s highest peak. Whether you’re craving a rustic alpine feast or a peaceful escape, this charming spot promises warmth, flavor, and unforgettable moments in the great outdoors.
